data_description.mac: Used only as a Wake-on-LAN fallback.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair Samsung TV IP Control again

data_description.mac: Used only as a Wake-on-LAN fallback. Leave empty to disable Wake-on-LAN.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the TV. Confirm the IP address, turn the TV on, and enable IP Remote.
error.certificate_mismatch: The TV's TLS certificate changed. Credentials were not transmitted. Verify the TV and network before pairing again.
error.authentication_failed: The TV rejected the saved access token. Close this flow and complete the reauthentication request first.
error.device_mismatch: The verified TV identity does not match this config entry. Check the address and select the original TV.
error.pairing_failed: Pairing failed. Close Samsung Home so an HDMI picture is visible, retry, and accept the prompt on the TV.
error.invalid_host: Enter a valid TV IP address or hostname.

abort.reauth_successful: Samsung TV IP Control was paired again.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The Samsung TV connection was updated.

init.title: Optional local text input
init.description: Text input uses the TV's separate local WebSocket remote service and separate authorization token. It does not use SmartThings or the cloud.

data_description.pair_text_input_again: Request a new local WebSocket token and trust the TV's current text-input certificate.

error.text_cannot_connect: Could not reach the TV's local text-input service. Confirm the TV is on and port 8002 is reachable.
error.text_certificate_mismatch: The TV's text-input certificate changed. Verify the physical TV and network before pairing again.
error.text_pairing_failed: Text-input pairing failed. Retry and accept the separate local remote prompt on the TV.

text_input_not_configured.message: Text input is not enabled. Open the integration's Configure flow to pair it.

text_input_authentication_failed.message: The TV rejected the text-input token. Open the integration's Configure flow and pair text input again.

text_input_certificate_mismatch.message: The TV's text-input certificate changed. Verify the physical TV and network before pairing text input again.

text_input_failed.message: The TV did not accept the text-input action. Confirm an on-screen text field is active.

send_text.name: Set text
send_text.description: Sets the complete non-sensitive value of the active on-screen input through a short-lived local WebSocket session.

text.name: Text
text.description: The complete printable field value. Use an empty value to clear the field. Do not use this action for passwords or other secrets.

submit.name: Finish input
submit.description: Ends the TV text-input sequence after setting the text. Application behavior varies.
